text: Regulatory approaches of the early 2020s largely undermined the evolution of decentralized technology, because decentralized solutions at their core negate external control, censorship, and oversight while the legal initiatives treated government control as indispensable.
citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Future of Decentralization (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782201
abstract: Yet, decentralized technology solutions, at their core, negate external control, censorship, and oversight. Accordingly, the then-proposed approaches largely under- mined the evolution of decentralized technology.
